Trapped within the eerie, mist-shrouded expanses of a desolate moor, a brilliant consulting detective and his loyal companion investigate a brutal murder tied to an ancient, supernatural hound. As suspicion falls upon the secretive heirs of a cursed estate, the duo must separate chilling folklore from cold-blooded reality. With time running out and danger lurking in every fog-laden shadow, they race to unmask a cunning killer before the legendary beast claims its next victim.
